import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

repo = Path("/Users/steventran/jobpipe")
py = str(repo / ".venv" / "bin" / "python")

commands = [
    [py, "-m", "py_compile", "jobpipe.py", "jobctl.py", "jobpipe_discovery.py", "utils/jobspy_source.py", "utils/tracker.py"],
    [py, "-m", "pytest", "-q", "tests/test_jobpipe_discovery.py"],
    [py, "jobpipe.py", "--help"],
]
for command in commands:
    run = subprocess.run(command, cwd=repo, capture_output=True, text=True)
    print("$", " ".join(command))
    print(run.stdout)
    print(run.stderr)
    if run.returncode != 0:
        raise SystemExit(run.returncode)
print("triage surface validation passed")
